prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive desktop pet controls tutorial screen: Adds an interactive desktop controls guide screen right after home_intro to walk users through hotkeys for summoning, hiding, and chatting with their pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_tutorial"], "home_intro": {"button_label": "Next: Pet Controls Guide"}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive split-view pet personality selector: Redesigns the pick_friend screen into a split stage layout featuring live animated pet previews alongside choice cards for companion traits.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Companion's Personality", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_preview", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Personality", "action": "choose", "style": "rounded"}]}}
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop display compatibility verification sub-flow: Inserts a screen prior to the waiting stage that verifies desktop overlay permissions and displays a test pet animation to confirm rendering.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_display_check", "waiting", "home_intro"], "waiting": {"hint": "Verifying desktop screen compatibility and rendering engine."}}
3: [choose_path, reorder] Story context scroll prior to path decision: Reorders onboarding so the story introduction screen appears before choose_path, giving context before users pick a path.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "story": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Pet World", "button_label": "Choose My Pet Path"}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing account pet sync warning hint: Displays a clear reminder hint on sign_in encouraging users to log in with their original sign-in method to avoid pet resets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Log in using your original account method to keep your existing desktop pet and progress intact."}}
5: [adoption, copy] Clear adoption certificate commitment callout: Updates headline and body text on adoption_certificate to clearly explain that naming their pet finalizes companion creation.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Name Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Give your new pet an official name to issue their adoption certificate and spawn them on your desktop."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen timer count update: Enables time estimation readout and a visual timer component on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "timer", "label": "Estimated build time: under 60 seconds", "style": "calm"}]}}
7: [finish, incentive] Starter item reward badge on home intro: Adds a starter gift item badge to home_intro rewarding users for completing onboarding.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Unlocked: Free Starter Pet Toy & Treat Pack!", "style": "playful"}]}}
8: [choose_path, layout] Stage spotlight layout for path options: Switches choose_path layout to spotlight layout to highlight key path features clearly.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight"}}
9: [adoption, hint] Photo upload quality requirement checklist: Adds a photo criteria checklist component on upload_photos detailing lighting and positioning for optimal pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Well-lit front view; Single pet in frame; Clear focus", "style": "subtle"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a new controls tutorial screen after home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.
Pick a friend must let the user choose a pet; selecting companion personality traits loses this required screen job.
Adding a display check sub-flow before the waiting screen is allowed inside onboarding.
Reordering onboarding steps while preserving all required screens is permitted.
Adding an account sign-in hint is allowed and does not violate any rule.
Updating adoption certificate headline and copy while maintaining its purpose is allowed.
Displaying an estimated build time during a real wait on the waiting screen is permitted.
Onboarding copy mentions free extras and gifts ('Free Starter Pet Toy & Treat Pack!'), violating pricing copy rules.
Redesigning the choose_path screen layout is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding a photo quality checklist component to upload_photos is permitted.
